items.who: Mrs. George Henderson (wife of George Henderson)
items.q: Well, this little boy across the street, he teaches Mr. Barberin.

ctx.s: Mrs. George Henderson (wife of George Henderson)
ctx.x: No, they don't play rebob style. You'd be surprised how you ought to come on. I guess we have a choice. As general boys play. I mean, for youngsters in St. Augustine, they are a genius. I mean, they haven't started jobs. Well, this little boy across the street, he teaches Mr. Barberin. Look, he had to join a union. He joined a union recently.
This little child. I don't know how many youngsters want to make a dick from that.
